method.source: Surviving canonical vector geometry. Original capture screenshots are missing.
method.exact: Same canonical part ID, independent of role, translation, rotation and mirroring. Separate IDs only merge at 0.000001 logical units with equal stroke widths. No extra IDs are merged automatically.
method.similar: Rigid alignment with reflection, no scaling; sampled symmetric contour distance and stroke-width difference. Candidate metrics support visual review; family labels do not prove identity.
method.units: 100 x 64 logical face coordinates. At 800 x 512, multiply distances by 8.
method.scope: All 40 canonical faces, 450 archived geometry frames, every studio frame directory, and surviving face-source derivatives. Robot CAD videos excluded.
